Joseph Conrad, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/joseph-conrad/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Joseph Conrad, the author and writer of the notes, died 1924 (Wikidata Q82925, P570 = 1924-08-03).

First publication of the texts used: 1896 to 1917 (SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories and novellas published between 1896 and 1917 by Joseph Conrad').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: every text was first published in 1917 or earlier, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States. The edition's statement of rights below says the same.
- Other countries: the only person whose words are in the text died in 1924 (1925 or earlier), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Short Fiction was compiled from short stories and novellas published between 1896 and 1917 by Joseph Conrad.
- Wikidata Q82925 (Joseph Conrad), P570 = 1924-08-03; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joseph_Conrad
